name: Wild Claw
texts: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit or gear from among them and play it, reducing its Energy cost by :rb_energy_5:. Recycle the rest. Then you may do this: Empower it.
manual: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck.
You may banish a unit or gear from among them and play it, reducing its Energy cost by :rb_energy_5:.
Then you may do this: Empower it.
